text: A third channel is measurement rather than economics: if regulation curbs misreporting, private fund advisers' performance would appear to decrease simply because managers are less able to inflate their monthly returns.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Private Fund Performance  – Evidence from 2010 – 2015 (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2816408
